name: Shimmer reverb: +12st pitch-shift into lush space
goal: Build a portable shimmer (Eno-style) send: pitch-shift the wet path by +12 semitones into a long lush reverb/convolution, optionally feedback the shifted delay for endless bloom, high-/low-cut the delay echoes before the reverb, and EQ the wet shimmer before dry blend.

source.title: Creating a Shimmer Reverb │ VAST Tips & Tutorials │ Heavyocity

prerequisites: Delay or pitch-shifter with feedback; long lush reverb/convolution; EQ on wet path

inputs.name: feedback_on
inputs.description: Enable feedback path for endless bloom

steps.action: Route a send: place a delay/pitch stage before the long reverb. Set pitch shift to +12 semitones so the shifted copy washes into the lush space.
Use a long lush reverb (or convolution with high lush/length) so the shifted signal sustains as a cloud.
steps.expect: Sustained shimmer tail, not a short slap

steps.action: For endless blossom: enable feedback on the delay/pitch path so each loop shifts again. Short delay times → rapid expansions; longer times → slower bloom intervals.
Tone-shape the delay echoes before reverb: cut lows so low end does not stack; shave brittle highs so the convolution/reverb is not harsh.
steps.expect: Cleaner shimmer without mud or brittle sparkle

steps.action: EQ the overall shimmer wet (e.g. high-pass low band; gentle brightness if needed) before blending with dry via mix/send level. Optionally explore delay after reverb or ducking wet from dry later.
steps.expect: Shimmer sits under/around dry pad without masking

verification: Wet path is pitched (~+12) into a long reverb
Delay/echo path is filtered (HP + gentle LP) before reverb
Feedback (if on) blooms without runaway low-end build
constraints: Ground every step in the source YouTube-provided Show-transcript text; do not invent UI paths or numeric settings not stated there.
